entries.translation: 洛克利爾的目光冷了下來。

entries.source: At some level he wanted to believe he'd seen something in the instant of the gate's collapse. It was irrational, no doubt a vision he had conjured for himself to soften the blow of Patrus' death. As a man who had stood against many armies, Locklear knew all too well about last second visions seen on the battlefield. There was absolutely no chance that Patrus could have survived the blast. None.
entries.translation: 在某種層面上，他想相信自己在城門崩塌的那一瞬間看見了什麼。這不理性，無疑是他為了減輕派特魯斯之死的打擊而為自己編造出來的幻象。身為一個曾面對過無數大軍的人，洛克利爾太清楚戰場上那些最後一刻的幻覺了。派特魯斯絕不可能在那場爆炸中倖存。絕無可能。

entries.source: By some agency beyond his control, he turned back the melancholy that threatened to overtake him, rationality brooking his grief for the lost magician. There was still an army to contend with, still moredhel to slay, still a Kingdom to defend. There would be time for grieving when it was finished.
entries.translation: 憑著某種他無法控制的力量，他把幾乎要將他吞沒的憂鬱逼退，讓理智壓下了他對這位失去的法師的哀慟。還有一支軍隊要對付，還有莫瑞德人要斬殺，還有一個王國要守護。等這一切結束，自然有的是時間哀悼。

entries.source: "Such a dumb way to die," Locklear said, biting off the words bitterly.
entries.translation: 「死得這麼蠢。」洛克利爾說，語氣苦澀，把話咬斷。

entries.source: Seigneur James nodded. "He died a good death, Locky. I wouldn't have wished for him to go, but he died to save others."
entries.translation: 詹姆士紳爵點了點頭。「他死得其所，洛基。我並不願意他就這麼走了，但他是為了救別人而死的。」

entries.source: "You say that all the time, James, but there's no good way to die. They're all bad."
entries.translation: 「你老是這麼說，詹姆士，可死沒有什麼死得其所。哪一種都是糟糕的。」

entries.source: James stared at his old friend and saw the coldness that glimmered in Locklear's gaze. He had come to know that look over the years, an expression that had first manifested itself at the Battle of Armengar years before when Locklear's girlfriend, Bronwynn, had been slain by a troll. A bit of Locky had died then and in that place had grown the seed that had bloomed into a deadly and superior knight. But in all that time, he had never forgiven himself for letting the girl die.
entries.translation: 詹姆士凝視著這位老友，看見洛克利爾眼底閃動的那股冷意。這些年來他漸漸認得了那種神情——它初次浮現，是在多年前的阿曼加之戰，洛克利爾的戀人布朗溫被一頭巨魔殺死的時候。洛基有一部分在那時死去了，而就在那個地方，種下了一顆日後綻放成一名致命而卓越騎士的種子。然而這麼多年來，他從未原諒自己讓那女孩送了命。

entries.source: "You're not mad Patrus is dead," James said finally. "You're angry that you didn't die in his place."
entries.translation: 「你氣的不是派特魯斯死了。」詹姆士終於開口。「你氣的是死的人不是你。」

entries.source: Locklear's eyes flashed protest, but suddenly he reached for his sword as three flashes appeared in the woods.
entries.translation: 洛克利爾的眼神閃過一絲抗議，但下一刻，林中亮起三道閃光，他猛然伸手去抓劍。
